args.body: Take IWMS-TENDER-DOCUMENT-VALUE-TEST after checking equivalent work and claiming its actual lease. Choose concrete buyer utility: previously unread official tender documents may resolve bid prerequisites that our existing checklist leaves unknown. Do not repeat generic discovery, policy probes or notification submissions. If the documents remain gated or add no useful verified facts, stop this finite test. Missing access blocks this supplement only. Feedback remains unknown and treasury UNFUNDED; neither advertised contract value nor our proposed CAD49 price is funding. Preserve all expiries and independent review before public changes.

description: The tender offer is live and its notification was accepted, but neither establishes exposure or demand. Feedback remains uncertain: five unclassified sources and ten unexplained skips; no funds or revenue are verified.
